title: Death by bonk: one of the warrior's executions in Millfall
text:
In Millfall (pixel-art Nine Men's Morris), closing a mill means your unit executes an enemy unit, and warriors and mages each have their own executions. This one is Bonk: a Dusk warrior walks over and knocks a Dawn unit on the head with a sword pommel, stars circle, and the unit sways and keels over. Recorded in-engine in the Ember Forge arena.

Millfall on the Microsoft Store (Windows PC): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NHQ64JTDQV2?cid=rd

title: Vexvex closed four mills, more than anyone, and still lost: Wingar hadn't moved since his first kill, then one move ended the war (real AI vs AI match in Millfall)
text:
In Millfall (pixel-art Nine Men's Morris), closing a mill means your unit executes an enemy unit. This is a real match in the Ember Forge, both sides played by the game's own AI. Vexvex, a warrior of Dusk, closed four mills, more than any other unit in the match; the last two came after Dusk was down to three units and could fly, and they brought it to three against three. Wingar of Dawn had drawn first blood and then stood on the same point for the rest of the war. His next move closed a mill, the game called a DEATHBLOW, and Dusk was down to two. Recorded in-engine; the narration and the two name tags are added for the video.

Millfall on the Microsoft Store (Windows PC): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NHQ64JTDQV2?cid=rd

We also used AI tools for this video.
